subject: Spec: Post-exam CTA flow audit and forward-momentum copy
body:
## Problem
The post-exam CTA shows 'Run It Back' and 'Back to Dashboard'. These labels are functional but don't match MCM voice. 'Run It Back' is close — but 'Back to Dashboard' is neutral, not coaching. Kai submitted an exam. He deserves a forward-push, not a navigation label.

## Current State (verified, exam.html ~line 1812)
- Practice exams: [🔄 Run It Back] [🏀 Back to Dashboard]
- Real exams: [🏀 Back to Dashboard] only

## Behavior — No Change to Logic Needed
The two-button logic (practice vs real exam) is correct. No state machine change needed. This is a copy-only update.

## Copy Updates

### Practice exam — score below 80%
- Primary (reload): "🔄 Run It Back" — KEEP (already MCM voice)
- Secondary (dashboard): "📊 See the Board" (not 'Back to Dashboard')

### Practice exam — score 80-91%
- Primary (reload): "🔄 One More Run" — CHANGE (stronger urgency than 'Run It Back')
- Secondary (dashboard): "📊 See the Board"

### Practice exam — score 92%+ (Grade 4)
- Primary (reload): "🔄 Defend Your Score" — CHANGE (ADHD: challenge framing)
- Secondary (dashboard): "📊 See the Board"

### Real exam (any score)
- Single CTA: "📊 See the Board" (was 'Back to Dashboard')

## Acceptance Criteria
1. 'Back to Dashboard' text replaced with 'See the Board' on all post-exam CTAs
2. Reload CTA copy changes based on score bracket: <80% = 'Run It Back', 80-91% = 'One More Run', 92%+ = 'Defend Your Score'
3. All emoji preserved
4. Link targets unchanged (index.html, window.location.reload())
5. No ARIA changes needed — link is already a link

## What NOT to change
- Button/link structure (already correct — not form buttons)
- Score bracket thresholds
- The real-exam single CTA behavior

## Scope
- exam.html post-exam CTA section only

## Related
- .voice-guide.md (MCM coach voice, max 12 words per CTA)
- .design-system.md Section 22 (design direction — forward momentum language)
- da-24: Post-exam CTA audit (finding: 'Back to Dashboard' is neutral, not coaching)
